identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of HRS-4642 Monotherapy or in Combination With Adebrelimab in the Treatment of Advanced Biliary Tract Tumors.
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study of HRS-4642 Monotherapy or in Combination With Adebrelimab in Patients With Advanced Biliary Tract Tumors.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The study was designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of HRS-4642 monotherapy or in combination with adebrelimab in the treatment of advanced biliary tract tumor patients.

armGroups.label: HRS-4642 monotherapy arm
armGroups.description: Patients will receive HRS-4642 monotherapy at a fixed dose.

armGroups.label: combination therapy arm
armGroups.description: Patients will receive HRS-4642 and adebrelimab combination therapy.
interventionNames: Drug: HRS-4642 and adebrelimab combination therapy

interventions.name: HRS-4642 monotherapy
interventions.description: HRS-4642 will be administrated per dose level in which the patients are assigned.

interventions.name: HRS-4642 and adebrelimab combination therapy
interventions.description: HRS-4642 and adebrelimab will be administrated per dose level in which the patients are assigned.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Objective response rate (ORR) by RECIST V1.1
primaryOutcomes.description: The ORR is defined as complete remission (CR) rate + partial remission (PR) rate by RECIST V1.1.
AEs and SAEs occurred from the first dose of treatment to 30 days after the last dose of HRS-4642 or 90 days after the last dose of adebrelimab (whichever comes late).

secondaryOutcomes.description: The DCR is defined as complete remission (CR) rate + partial remission (PR) rate + stable disease (SD).
PFS is defined as Time from the date of enrollment to of disease
OS is defined as time from the date of enrollment to data of death from any cause, or date of lost follow-up, whichever comes first, and otherwise censored at time last known alive.

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. 18-75 years old, male or female.
2. Histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced biliary tract cancer.
3. Unresectable or metastatic advanced patients with progression or intolerance for ≥ one line of systemic therapy, including patients who metastasize during or within 6 months after neoadjuvant or adjuvant therapy (adjuvant therapy or neoadjuvant therapy must include gemcitabine-based chemotherapy).
4. Have at least one measurable lesion according to the Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST v1.1).
5. ECOG performance status of 0-1.
6. With a life expectancy of ≥3 months.
7. Have adequate laboratory parameters and organ functions during the screening period.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Known history of hypersensitivity to any components of HRS-4642 or adebrelimab.
2. Prior anti-tumor chemotherapy within 4 weeks before the study drug administration. Small molecular targeted drugs (including oral targeted drugs for other clinical trials) with a half-life of less than 5 or 7 days from the first medication.
3. Patients with untreated or active central nervous system tumor metastasis.
4. Other factors that may affect the study results or lead to forced termination of the study early as judged by investigators.
